title: hermie-cards block
description: The body of a fenced code block whose language is `hermie-cards`. A JSON null is the same as an absent key (it never fails a block). Rules that JSON Schema cannot say are in README.md section 3 and are enforced by the validators: at most one highlighted card, a connector label never on the last card, tags unique within a card after trimming, every string trimmed (an empty one is absent), lengths counted in characters as a reader sees them, and the text of the block at most 16384 bytes of UTF-8, checked before it is parsed.

icon.description: A name from icons.json, matched without regard to case. A name that is not in it draws the generic glyph (decision D3); it never refuses the block.
